{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Assassin}}
{{Quote|Why would you be better than an armored battle droid?"<br />"Disclosure: Finesse. Battle droids hold battlefields. I am capable of eliminating a very... specific type of target.|[[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[HK-47]]|<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Assassin_droid_kotor.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An [[Mark VII experimental prototype assassin droid|assassin droid]] from around the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KOTOR" />]]

'''Assassin droids''' were specialized [[Droid/Legends|droids]] designed for carrying out '''assassinations''' on [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings, typically on behalf of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]], corrupt [[Politics/Legends|politicians]], or [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] against their adversaries. The modern assassin droids predecessors were initially manufactured and built to perform law enforcement duties; however, over time, as these droids fell into the wrong hands - they would be repurposed and utilized by nefarious entities to carry out their dirty work, serving as the genesis of a new type of killing machine.

==History==
[[File:Assassin_droid_TOR.jpg|thumb|left|150px|An assassin droid in [[3653 BBY]]]]
Originally, assassin droids were developed in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a law-enforcement droid designed to keep the peace by either capturing or otherwise killing violent criminals. Several were later repurposed as [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]] for the Outer Rim frontiers as well as the Corporate Sector.<ref name="EGC">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

When a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], corrupt [[Politics/Legends|politician]], or [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] required an individual to be eliminated, they sometimes deployed or hired an assassin droid to execute their will. These droids generally performed with unflinching loyalty to their masters, but rogue assassin droids were not unknown. Since their missions generally required a far higher degree of independent skill, savvy, and judgment than normally possessed by simple [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]], their programming subroutines, circuitry, and memory cores were of correspondingly higher sophistication and quality.

Equipped with an array of weapons, assassin droids were also used as elite infantry when the need arose for skillful and quickly adaptable soldiers with unquestionable loyalty, as with the [[A-series assassin droid|Confederacy assassin droids]] deployed during the [[Battle of Jabiim]].

The [[Jin'ha]] also produced [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] [[Trade Federation assassin droid|assassin droids]] for the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

[[File:ASN_assassin_droid.jpg|thumb|right|180px|[[ASN courier droid/Legends|ASN]] assassin droid at work.]]
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caprioril]] was the site of the infamous assassin droid tragedy shortly before the fall of the Galactic Republic, in which a droid slaughtered 20,000 [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] and [[Alien/Legends|aliens]] at a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop]] arena in a massive explosion in order to assassinate [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Amel Bakli]].<ref name="Rebellion">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> Because of this, as well as the assassination droids' gradual misuse by politicians, crime lords, and warlords, there were attempts by the Galactic Senate during the waning days of the Old Republic to have them banned, although this ultimately failed.<ref name="EGC" /> Ironically, it was during the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] ordered all assassin droids banned throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] due to their constant use against himself and his forces, with it being largely more successful. However, despite the Imperial ban, another Imperial, that of [[Holowan Laboratories/Legends|Holowan Laboratories]] Supervisor [[Gurdun]], ordered the creation of the [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88 assassin droids]], which later betrayed both him and his forces.

In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], assassin droids flooded the market thanks to [[Lannik Racto]], a crime lord on Coruscant, but his operation was ended by Jedi [[Jaden Korr]]. These assassin droid models featured hand energy weapons and a powerful nimbus of electricity that delivered a near-fatal shock upon contact. The droids could not fire and maintain the nimbus at the same time, however.

An inordinate number of assassin droids achieved sentient independence, including IG-88 and [[C-3PX]]. This is presumably due to the higher level of autonomy that is incorporated into an assassin droid's droid-"brain" processor design since independence is a functional requirement. These droids with no masters typically fund their independent existences through the use of their innate abilities, plying their trade as bounty hunters.

[[File:ScarabDroidDiagram-FF98.png|thumb|left|250px|A Scarab Mark VI assassin droid]]
Some assassin droids included [[HK-47]], the [[HK-50 series assassin droid|HK-50 series]], IG-88, [[ASN-121/Legends|ASN-121]], [[2-124]], C-3PX, [[SCr-114]], [[A-77]], an [[Unidentified Imperial assassin droid|Imperial model]] and the [[Human replica droid]] [[Guri]].

[[21 BBY/Legends|One year after]] the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was sent to Cestus to investigate the production of the [[JK-13 security droid|JK-13]] droid line by Cestus Cybernetics. The JK-13 was also known as Jedi Killers among the criminal classes and possessed shields. The JK droids were sold for almost a year throughout the galaxy.

Listed in Peterson's Guide to Droids of the Republic, Vol. VII: The Great Corporate Expansion Era, the [[Tac-Spec Corporation]] [[FIII Footman droid]]s are considered legendary, among the deadliest personal service units ever created combining fanatical loyalty and an impressive kill ratio. These droids were both enormously expensive and on a limited production run.
